title: Conference
description: Represents participation in a conference, event, symposium, convention, or professional gathering.

name.title: Conference Name
name.description: The official name or title of the conference or event.

role.title: Participation Role
role.description: The role performed or capacity held at the conference or event.

attendance.title: Conference Attendance
attendance.description: Information about the conference or event was attended.

type.title: Conference Type
type.description: An additional label related to the conference.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date or year of attendance.

dateLabel.title: Date Label
dateLabel.description: The human-readable start date displayed to users.

description.title: Description
description.description: A list of statements describing the conference participation.

items.title: Description Statement
items.description: A statement describing the conference participation.
